content:
Maya L: Quick thread - final relnotes draft is in relnotes/feature-rollup. Need: 3 short bullets, Known Issues paragraph, and snippet parity across Py/TS/Go. Also a link sweep for old migration anchors.

eric: I'll run the snippets and update param names; saw one CLI example using `--old-flag`.

zoe: Found two redirecting links on the migration guide. I'll replace them with canonical docs paths and add a short comment for reviewers.

i18n-bot: Heads-up: any copy changes under /docs/relnotes/* require i18n keys. Please include key list in PR.

eric: Py/TS pass locally after small rename (max_tokens -> max_output_tokens). Opening PR with patches and a checklist for l10n.

Maya L: Add Known Issue: "Cold-start requests may see ~1s extra latency due to cache warming; embeddings may shift slightly after tokenizer update." Ops asked to call that out.

deploy-bot: Preview build available: https://preview.redwood/relnotes/3170001234 (build #8).

Maya L: Target: merge by tomorrow 9am PT, then publish. If anything blocks, flag here and tag release lead.
